entries.name: Frozo "Frozenfire" Ferno
info: Project X : Ice Fire Rare Clan Descendant

He was a child of rare clans of ice and fire. Born to father Brian Bonfire and mother Emily Winters, the tale started as Brian was evicted from his apartment and became small time criminal so he can survive in the harsh world. He has the power to control fire, a genetic ability that can only happen once in a decade. Then during a job working as a bodyguard for the Winters family, he met Emily Winters. Then the rest (a true story of forbidden love that rivals the Romeo and Juliet, and also he fought Emily's pyschotic brother Daniel "Thundra" Winters") is history (that worth a screenplay of). Then he was born.

He was born to a father Brian Bonfire and mother Emily Winters, a runaway from both clans due to their predisposed animosity with each other. As a kid, Frozo is trained in handling both elements by both of his parents, and became one of the first member of Project X.

edit.name: Ned "Nothingness" Neverbrau
bio: Ned "Nothingness" Neverbrau is the No. 1 swordsman in the world, wielding one of the 7 Great Swords, "The Infinity". Ned found the sword in his backyard after a mysterious meteor shower hit his city, the byproduct of Master Knife's vicious rampage. He is rumoured to have killed 1000 challengers for his title, all of them former member of the 100 Good Swordsmen. It is also rumoured that he has direct contact with The Creator through his sword, as the sword is one of The Creator's Gifts.

skills.name: It's Nothing
text: Ned "Nothingness" Neverbrau are granted superhuman level of endurance. The damage of the first attack that hits him gets halved, but subsequent attack's damage gets doubled.

skills.name: Infinity Slash
text: Ned "Nothingness" Neverbrau slashes an enemy multiple times, dealing heavy damage. Enemies inflicted by the debuff "Wounds: Sound of Nothing" will explode outward, dealing damage to all enemies and remove the debuff. If there's other enemies beside them that also have the debuff "Wounds: Sound of Nothing", they also explode outward and deals damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Hailstorm of Infinity

edit.name: O'Neil "O" Scherjarsky
edit.power: Project X: Invisible Barrier/Telekinetic Potion Inventor, Material Ball Dispenser Inventor
bio: O'Neil "O" Scherjarsky is a chemist, engineer, and inventor affiliated with Project X. He invented The Dispenser, a machinery that can create solid ball material out of anything, including dirt. The machinery has a container included, to input material into, including used ball of material. He also perfected a mixture of Invisible Barrier and Telekinetic potions, which was only powerful enough to levitate the ball material produced by The Dispenser.

skills.name: "O" Punch

edit.name: Quentino Qiraq
bio: Quentino Qiraq is a Power Fruit researcher, who ate the first artificial fruit ever created by human hands, the Quentin Fruit. The fruit, however, grants him the power to infect people with a viral infection, dubbed the "Quentin Virus". This power immediately brought chaos to the Earthworld, due to its quick spread and difficulty in creating a cure to combat it. The chaos grew so much that The Creator were forced to appear for the first time since the Master Knife incident years prior, and brought Quentino deep underground in a special holding place, not risking his power to infect the Deleted World by deleting him.

sections.title: Element Bender
intro: In the Benderverse, there are 4 groups of powered people that can "bend" an element. Earth, fire, air, water. And with them exists an Avatar, which can bend all 4 element and then some. The Avatar can reincarnate through each group of bender in what would be known as the Avatar Cycle.

entries.name: Earthbender
info: With the obvious largest concentration around the Benderverse, earthbenders bends the earth in their feet. The Earth Kingdom was the largest community out of any other bending community, and makes up for almost all of the continent.

entries.name: Firebender
info: Lived under the banner of militaristic Fire Nation, firebenders use their overwhelming will to their task and desire to conjure flame. They're the only group that can conjure their element out of nothing. They are well-known for their aggressive attacking style and the one that started the Hundred Years Wars.
